notes: The document argues for the symmetry identified as (3): it first treats one cycle in the Albanese kernel by translation, then moves a cycle to make intersections defined, uses an application x ↦ a+b−x for component symbols, and invokes linearity and earlier formulas (2). These are document claims, not independently verified theorems in this run.
The last paragraph asserts a vanishing property for j_o and starts a function argument ending with telle que; the continuation is not supplied.

Typed page number 101 appears at the top right; a handwritten archive sheet number 101 appears at the lower left. No title, date, or stated total count appears on this page. H’s terminal Corollaire kummérien ... section heading is editorial and is not counted as ink or as a discrepancy. An omitted H page macro is likewise not counted as a wrong number.
The exact phrase composants de A is retained. The capital A is visible; no correction to underlined a is made.

The insertion reads , en posant Y=X_u-X. The comma and en are at the right end of L6; posant and the equation are at the left margin of L7. There is no need to invent a caret: the immediate spatial continuation fixes the reading order.

No cancellations were identified. Handwritten mathematical completions are separately inventoried; the identity of the hand is not assigned. Small round marks may not permit a confident distinction of writing technique at every recurrence, so no claim about correction chronology is made.

The three retained ambiguity families are lower o/0, application-name zeta/xi, and upper circle/o/0. The first occurrence of each is marked in reading.tex; recurrences use its first candidate. Difference rows at recurrences identify uncertainty missing from H even where its literal first candidate agrees.
Four separate upper bars on underlined k are visible. The plain a beneath D in the first paragraph lacks an underline. These are ink observations, not corrections from algebraic expectations.

The upper-left arc and the short lower-left dark stroke are nonverbal marginal marks. A twelfth local crop inspected two diffuse brown-grey traces at the upper right; their shapes are reproduced conservatively without assigning material, maker, handwriting, or textual intention.
No mathematical proof check, re-proof, or computation was performed. Mathematical context was used only to locate symbols for comparison; it supplied no missing text or distinguishing strokes.
Only the assigned brief, page bundle, preamble, whole image, halves and crops were read. The whole and each half were displayed once. No OCR, web, other page, or other reader output was used.

Input limitation: the originally supplied C_prior_questions.md inadvertently included title/number metadata rows for scans 113–116. Those out-of-assignment rows were encountered in the required file read, were ignored for this page, and no images or witnesses for those scans were opened. The parent later reported their removal. No current-page reading changed and no image was reopened.
